originalTitle: China achieves over 180 GW of new-type energy storage capacity by end of 2027?
title: 中国 2027 年底新型储能装机会超过 180 GW 吗？
Will China exceed 180 GW of installed new-type storage by end-2027?
rules: 按国家能源局等官方数据，中国 2027 年底已安装新型储能功率须 >180 GW。
Official NEA or equivalent data must show >180 GW installed new-type storage power at end-2027.
统计对象是新型储能功率，不是 GWh 能量、在建项目或抽水蓄能。
The measure is new-type storage power, not GWh, construction pipeline or pumped hydro.
interpretation: 本题以功率规模判定。国家能源局披露的 2024 年底 73.76 GW／168 GWh 为不同单位的基准；未来政策目标不应当作提前完成的投运数据。
This contract measures power. NEA’s end-2024 73.76 GW/168 GWh baseline uses two different units; a future policy target is not completed operational deployment.

summary: 本题以功率规模判定。国家能源局披露的 2024 年底 73.76 GW／168 GWh 为不同单位的基准；未来政策目标不应当作提前完成的投运数据。
This contract measures power. NEA’s end-2024 73.76 GW/168 GWh baseline uses two different units; a future policy target is not completed operational deployment.
checklist: 确认统计时点为 2027 年底。
区分功率、能量和投运状态。
Separate power, energy and operating status.
保留官方统计定义，避免把全部储能归为某一化学体系。
Retain the official definition rather than assigning every project to one chemistry.

stage: 项目建设 → 并网投运 → 官方装机统计
impact: 国家能源局的已投运统计提供可追踪基准，比各企业产能相加更适合本题。锂离子、液流、压缩空气等路线都可能进入新型储能合计，市场价格反映的是总装机门槛，不能用来比较单独某一种正极、电解液或电池材料的成功率。

NEA operating statistics provide a traceable baseline, unlike adding manufacturers’ capacities. Lithium-ion, flow and compressed-air systems may all contribute. This is a deployment threshold, not a success probability for a cathode, electrolyte or chemistry.
gap: 细则写超过 180 GW，精确等于 180 GW 不自动满足；政策目标与市场严格不等号须分别核对。
The contract says strictly over 180 GW; a policy goal or exactly 180 GW is not automatically sufficient.

title: 电池储能的 GW 与 GWh
Battery storage in GW and GWh
principle: 电堆或变流器限制功率，电极或电解液总量影响能量。并网储能统计还需区分公用事业级与住宅工商等范围，不能把功率与能量相加。
Stacks and converters limit power while electrode or electrolyte inventory affects energy. Statistics distinguish utility and distributed sectors; power and energy are not additive.
example: EIA 记录的超过 26 GW 是公用事业级功率，市场 260 GWh 则是多部门能量阈值，原题固定的 130 GWh 只作为规则常数显示。
EIA’s over 26 GW measures utility-scale power; the market’s 260 GWh is a multisector energy threshold, with 130 GWh retained solely as a rule constant.

label: 严格大于的功率门槛
Strict power threshold
detail: 原规则要求 >180 GW；不要与政策“以上”、GWh 能量或在建产能混用。
The rule is >180 GW, distinct from policy wording, GWh and construction capacity.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
